description: Golden evaluation dataset for the Anime RAG Recommender. Used by RAGAS to measure faithfulness and answer relevancy.

samples.question: I want a dark psychological anime with morally complex characters
samples.ground_truth: Dark psychological anime with complex characters include Death Note, Monster, and Neon Genesis Evangelion. These titles explore moral ambiguity, manipulation, and the human psyche.

samples.question: Recommend a romantic anime set in high school
samples.ground_truth: Popular romantic high school anime include Toradora, Clannad, and Your Lie in April. These feature teenage love stories, emotional growth, and school settings.

samples.question: I like action anime with a strong female lead
samples.ground_truth: Action anime with strong female protagonists include Akame ga Kill, Claymore, and Kill la Kill. These feature powerful female characters driving the main narrative.

samples.question: Looking for a fantasy anime with a complex magic system
samples.ground_truth: Fantasy anime with detailed magic systems include Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood, Black Clover, and Magi. These feature well-defined rules governing supernatural abilities.

samples.question: I want a slice of life anime that is calming and relaxing
samples.ground_truth: Calming slice of life anime include Barakamon, Laid-Back Camp, and Non Non Biyori. These are peaceful shows focused on everyday moments and simple joys.

samples.question: Recommend a mecha anime with deep philosophical themes
samples.ground_truth: Philosophical mecha anime include Neon Genesis Evangelion, Code Geass, and Gurren Lagann. These explore identity, free will, and the cost of power through giant robot battles.

samples.question: I enjoy sports anime with intense competition and teamwork
samples.ground_truth: Intense sports anime include Haikyuu, Kuroko no Basket, and Free. These feature underdog teams, training arcs, and high-stakes tournament competitions.

samples.question: Looking for a historical anime set in feudal Japan
samples.ground_truth: Historical anime set in feudal Japan include Rurouni Kenshin, Samurai Champloo, and Dororo. These explore samurai culture, political conflict, and the Edo or Sengoku periods.

samples.question: I want a sci-fi anime exploring artificial intelligence and humanity
samples.ground_truth: Sci-fi anime about AI and humanity include Ghost in the Shell, Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song, and Psycho-Pass. These examine consciousness, what it means to be human, and technology's impact on society.

samples.question: Recommend an anime with excellent world-building and lore
samples.ground_truth: Anime with rich world-building include Made in Abyss, Attack on Titan, and Hunter x Hunter. These feature immersive fictional worlds with deep histories and internal logic.

samples.question: I like comedy anime that are genuinely funny
samples.ground_truth: Genuinely funny comedy anime include Gintama, Konosuba, and The Devil is a Part-Timer. These are known for consistent humor, absurdist situations, and well-timed jokes.

samples.question: Looking for an anime about friendship and adventure
samples.ground_truth: Adventure anime focused on friendship include One Piece, Fairy Tail, and Sword Art Online. These center on bonds between characters during high-stakes journeys.

samples.question: I want an anime with mystery and suspense
samples.ground_truth: Mystery anime with strong suspense include Erased, Another, and The Promised Neverland. These feature plot twists, investigative narratives, and persistent tension.

samples.question: Recommend an anime that made everyone cry
samples.ground_truth: Emotionally impactful anime known to cause tears include Clannad After Story, Anohana, and Violet Evergarden. These deal with loss, grief, and the lasting power of human connection.

samples.question: I enjoy anime with anti-heroes and morally ambiguous protagonists
samples.ground_truth: Anime with anti-hero protagonists include Code Geass, Death Note, and Overlord. These feature protagonists who pursue goals through questionable or ruthless means.

samples.question: Looking for a short anime I can finish in one day
samples.ground_truth: Short anime completable in one day include Anohana (11 episodes), Violet Evergarden (13 episodes), and Erased (12 episodes). These are concise stories with high emotional payoff.

samples.question: I want an isekai anime where the protagonist is overpowered
samples.ground_truth: Isekai anime with overpowered protagonists include Overlord, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, and Re:Zero. These feature characters transported to another world with exceptional abilities.

samples.question: Recommend an anime about music or performing arts
samples.ground_truth: Anime about music and performance include Your Lie in April, Beck, and Nana. These explore passion, talent, and the emotional depth of artistic expression.

samples.question: I want a horror anime that is genuinely scary
samples.ground_truth: Genuinely scary horror anime include Higurashi, Shiki, and Parasyte. These feature unsettling atmospheres, psychological dread, and disturbing imagery.

samples.question: Looking for an anime suitable for someone who has never watched anime before
samples.ground_truth: Good starter anime for newcomers include Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood, Attack on Titan, and My Hero Academia. These are accessible, well-paced, and represent the best of the medium.
